q: How long will my order take?
a: In-stock pieces leave the workshop in 3-5 business days and arrive in metro areas within a week. Made-to-order upholstery runs 6-8 weeks; we confirm your build slot by email within 48 hours of ordering.
Yes. Metro delivery across all capital cities is a flat $149, free over $2,000. Regional and remote deliveries are quoted individually at checkout so there are no surprises.
Our team brings the piece into the room of your choice, unpacks it, assembles anything that needs assembling, and takes every scrap of packaging away with them.

q: Can I return something if it doesn't suit the room?
a: You have 30 days from delivery. The piece needs to be in original condition. We arrange collection and refund in full minus the return freight, which we quote up front.

q: What is covered by the warranty?
a: Ten years on all frames and joinery, five years on suspension and foam, two years on hardware and finishes. It covers manufacturing faults, not normal wear or accidental damage.

q: Do you offer an interior design service?
a: We do. A one-hour consultation is free for orders over $3,000 and $180 otherwise, credited back if you order within 30 days. It can be in the Adelaide showroom or over video.

q: Can I see the pieces in person?
a: Our showroom is at 118 Rundle Street, Adelaide, open seven days. Most of the catalogue is on the floor, and we can bring fabric and timber samples out for anything that isn't.

q: How do I care for the timber and fabric?
a: Every order ships with a care card specific to your finish. In short: dry cloth for dust, blot spills immediately, re-oil timber twice a year, and keep everything out of direct afternoon sun.
